content: Vbvrikunamv nyido tolo kairungnv okv angu sirungnv, kvvbi kaakwmanam akodv kaato oogv nyidogindung vdwv kanw gobv rito vv chilichilum lvvma kanwgo aagv la aato, vv ataranya gv chinyungchinya akin vmwngku, ogulvgavbolo bunu vdwv Pwknvyarnv gv haachi nama anyunganya bv kaatam nvnv vku.

Hokokwng lokuring ngo lvko kaadv tunamv glass gv svmasa akolo vmv dooyo sinam aingbv kaapato. Yvvbunudw svnwng am okv ninyigv murti okv amin am numbur bv lvklwk konv am rigum yala ripvdw ho vdwaka ngo kaato. Pwknvyarnv gv bunua jikunam harp bajanvnv am bunu vdwv bvngtola okv glass gv svmasa adarlo dakto.
Okv Pwknvyarnv gv pakbu, Moses gv mirimimpak gaana nga okv Svlarkuu gv mirimimpak gaana nga vbv gaadungto:

content.text: noogv kudungkua rinam si vdwgo kairungnamgo okv kaasartabo rungnamgo!
Noogv lamtv dvdv ngv vdwgo sursinv okv jvjvnv!
Ahtu, nam yvvla busu mabv rire?
Nam yvvka miang nvgobv vla mila mare?
Diringmooku mvnwng ngv nokv lo aare
Ogulvgavbolo noogv jvjvbv rinam dvdv nga mvnwng ngv kaapa roku.”

content: Soogv kokwngbv chikuknam nyidomooku tolo, Pwknvyarnvnaam am ngo kaato hogv lvkobv Darwknv Tombu vka dooto.
Chilichilum lvvma kanw nga aagvnv nyidogindung kanwv, darwknv unglitnv vji am gvvtoku okv haakwng lo ain hokpo puching sito kula Pwknvyarnvnaam lokv linto.
Vbvrikunamv oogv turnv pwknamyarnam api lokv akin gonv nyidogindung kanw am ain talu pwkkanwgo jito, um talu pwkkanw lo turbwngnv Pwknvyarnv gv haachiv akomaring toku.

Pwknvyarnvnaam lo Pwknvyarnv gv yunglitnam lokv okv Jwkrw lokv mvkwmvya ngv akomaring pvvtoku, okv nyidogindung kanw vdwgv lokv chilichilum kanwgo aagv nam vdwv kudungkua nga rinyama dvdvlo yvvka Pwknvyarnvnaam lo aala mato.
